# Theseus

> Theseus is Finland's open access repository for academic theses from universities of applied sciences, managed by ARENE ry.

Theseus aggregates bachelor and master theses from all Finnish ammattikorkeakoulut (universities of applied sciences) in a single searchable digital archive. The platform provides free access to academic publications under Creative Commons licensing with standardized metadata and URN identifiers.

- Thesis Repository

## Getting Started

- [Theseus Repository Home](http://submissions.theseus.fi): Theseus open access thesis repository by ARENE ry for Finnish universities
- [Search Guide](https://submissions.theseus.fi/hakuohje.htm): Search guide for Theseus with Boolean operators and advanced search syntax

## University Collections

- [Centria University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/1900): Centria University of Applied Sciences thesis collection in Theseus
- [Diakonia University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/1552): Diakonia University of Applied Sciences thesis repository in Theseus
- [Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/431): Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences thesis collection
- [Hämen University of Applied Sciences (HAMK)](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/1766): HAMK thesis repository with academic publications and research archive
- [Högskolan på Åland](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/99099): Högskolan på Åland thesis collection in Theseus database
- [Humanistinen University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/2050): Humanistinen University of Applied Sciences thesis repository
- [Jyväskylän University of Applied Sciences (JAMK)](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/5): JAMK thesis repository with bachelor and master theses collections
- [Kaakkois-Suomen University of Applied Sciences (XAMK)](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/121364): XAMK thesis database with bachelor and master theses
- [Kajaani University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/1967): Kajaani University of Applied Sciences thesis collection
- [Karelia University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/1620): Karelia UAS thesis repository with academic publications
- [Kymenlaakson University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/1493): Kymenlaakson University of Applied Sciences thesis archive
- [LAB University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/266372): LAB University of Applied Sciences thesis repository
- [Lahti University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/10): Lahti University of Applied Sciences thesis database
- [Lapland University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/69720): Lapland University of Applied Sciences thesis repository
- [Laurea University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/12): Laurea University of Applied Sciences thesis collection
- [Metropolia University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/6): Metropolia University of Applied Sciences thesis repository
- [Mikkeli University of Applied Sciences](https://www.theseus.fi/handle/10024/2074): Mikkeli University of Applied Sciences thesis archive
